(west) / VIADUCT (east) from State ENE over Willow and Garrard, recorded as 'Harrison Avenue Viaduct' (as in 22-31R; its crossings are probably grade-separated); Willow Street (WILLOW ... STREET, 60') from the upper Harrison road (unlabelled NNW segment north of the viaduct) south to a dead end at y~3715; Station Street (STATION ST.) from the railroad west of the creek east to Willow (50' west end, 60' east; slight downward slope eastward, no real jog at the tracks); Garrard Avenue (GARRARD / AVE., 60') along the right edge, its east line is the plate edge (x~10128-10145), centre drifting from x~10083 at the top to ~10098 at the bottom (no bend); stubs east of Garrard (labels cut off on this scan, read on the LoC scan 22-31R of the same plate): Duck (DUCK), Bank (BANKS), Dayton (DAYTON), Exeter (EXETER), an unlabelled ~25 ft stub = York Street by position (22-10L), Poplar (POPLAR), Sherman Avenue (SHERMAN AVE.); West Liberty Street (W. No stubs east of Garrard between Bank and Dayton, Dayton and Exeter, or York and Poplar (the alleys and Findlay Street of 22-10L do not reach this plate). Not streets: the railroads and sidings (60' strips; the B&O S.W., C.L.&N. diagonal and the yard tracks), the Mill Creek, the freight depot, the narrow strips beside the lot blocks (2)-(22) and 25-32 west of the creek (lots with frontage ditto marks on both sides; sidings cross them), lot/property lines meeting Garrard (y~4200, ~4620) and Liberty (x~8815), boundary bands, the 6 in. water pipe line along x~10105 (y 2000-2310).
